qa.question: I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, and another of my Digimon with <Collision> is attacking. I used the <Collision> effect to give <Blocker> to an opponent's Digimon that didn't originally have <Blocker>, and it blocks. At such times, if both Digimon have the same DP, they both lose the battle, and they're deleted, does this card's inherited effect trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, it triggers.

qa.question: A Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards battled an opponent's Digimon, and both Digimon lost the battle and were deleted. Can I activate this card's inherited effect at such times?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
The Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is deleted before this card's inherited effect activates, therefore it can't be activated.

qa.question: I have a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, other Digimon battled, and both Digimon lost the battle and were deleted. At such times, if both Digimon have <Blocker>, how many times does this card's inherited effect trigger?
qa.answer:
It triggers once.
If both Digimon lose a battle, both are deleted at the same time.

qa.question: Does this card's effect reference the card for the Digimon before or after it digivolves?
qa.answer: It references the Digimon after it digivolves.

qa.question: Can this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect delete this Digimon even when my opponent has no Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: I used this card's [Your Turn] effect to attach [End of Attack] to BT16-011 [Garudamon (X Antibody)] and BT13-014 [Garudamon]'s inherited effects. If I use BT13-014 [Garudamon]'s inherited effect to delete my opponent's BT13-065 [PlatinumSukamon] at the end of this card's attack, then <De-Digivolve> causes this card's [Your Turn] effect to be removed, can I then activate BT16-011 [Garudamon (X Antibody)]'s inherited effect?
qa.answer:
No, it can't be activated.
If the trigger conditions are no longer met before activation, it can't be activated.

qa.question: Does this card’s [All Turns] effect activate when a security card is removed from my security stack by one of my own effects?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: After gaining <Security A. +1> from this card's [All Turns] effect during my opponent's turn, can this Digimon gain <Security A. +1> again from this card's [All Turns] effect during my next turn?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect twice when I use one of my Digimon with <Security Attack +1> to check 2 cards in my opponent's security stack?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This effect is triggered "when a card is removed from your opponent's security stack," so even when you check multiple cards in your opponent's security stack, it is triggered and activates upon the first check. Also, this is a [Once Per Turn] effect, so this effect activates when a card is removed from their security stack upon the first check, and you can't activate the effect again upon the next check.

qa.question: If the [All Turns] effect gives this Digimon <Security A. +1> when this card attacks and I check my opponent's security stack, do I get an additional security check?
qa.answer: Yes, you do.

qa.question: An opponent's Digimon with <Security A. +1> and 8000 DP or less attacked and a security check occurred. If I use this card's [All Turns] effect to delete my opponent's attacking Digimon before the 2nd security check is performed, can I prevent the 2nd security check?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: My Digimon attacked a player and a security check occurred. If this card leaves the battle area due to the revealed card's [Security] effect, does this card’s [All Turns] effect activate?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn’t activate.
The effect triggers when a card is removed from a security stack, but this card is removed from the battle area before it can activate.

qa.question: This card digivolved from [BT14-018 Goldramon]. This Digimon gains all effects of [Goldramon] in digivolution cards, but does [BT14-018 Goldramon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activate?
qa.answer:
Yes, it activates.
This card's "this Digimon gains all effects of [Goldramon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards" effect is an [All Turns] effect, so it will activate as soon as the digivolution is confirmed. Therefore, [When Evolving] effects are gained and will trigger.

qa.question: This card digivolved from [EX3-035 Goldramon]. This Digimon gains all effects of [Goldramon] in digivolution cards, but after [EX3-035 Goldramon]'s [When Digivolving] effect activates and I return [EX3-069 Trial of the Four Great Dragons] from the trash to the hand, can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use [EX3-069 Trial of the Four Great Dragons] from my hand?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If this card's [All Turns] effect is used to gain a [When Digivolving] effect, this card's [When Digivolving] effect and the [When Digivolving] effect gained from the [All Turns] effect will trigger simultaneously upon the digivolution timing, therefore you may choose the activation order.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to activate an [On Deletion] effect at the end of an attack if the effect has conditions for activating, such as [EX4-053 Falcomon]'s inherited effect?
qa.answer: No. The effect will trigger, but it can't be activated because its conditions aren't met.

qa.question: I used this card's [Your Turn] effect to attach [End of Attack] to BT16-011 [Garudamon (X Antibody)] and BT13-014 [Garudamon]'s inherited effects. If I use BT13-014 [Garudamon]'s inherited effect to delete my opponent's BT13-065 [PlatinumSukamon] at the end of this card's attack, then <De-Digivolve> causes this card's [Your Turn] effect to be removed, can I then activate BT16-011 [Garudamon (X Antibody)]'s inherited effect?
qa.answer:
No, it can't be activated.
If the trigger conditions are no longer met before activation, it can't be activated.

qa.question: This card has BT16-016 [Patamon] in its digivolution cards and attacked an opponent's Digimon that has 1 digivolution card. At such times, can I use BT16-016 [Patamon]'s inherited effect to trash the digivolution card of the opponent's Digimon and then activate this card's [Your Turn] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's [All Turns] effect triggers when this card attacks an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards.
It won't trigger if it attacks a Digimon with digivolution cards, therefore you can't activate it.

qa.question: Does this card's effect reference the card for the Digimon before or after it digivolves?
qa.answer: It references the Digimon after it digivolves.

qa.question: Does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect prevent deletion in battles against Security Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, it prevents deletion.

qa.question: If both my hand and my opponent's hand increase when we both draw 1 card from our decks using an effect such as BT16-020 [GaoGamon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, does my opponent add 2 cards from the top of their security stack to the hand using this card's [Your Turn] effect?
qa.answer:
No, they don’t.
Although cards are added to both players' hands, they are added at the same timing, therefore your opponent only adds 1 card from their security stack to the hand.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "unsuspend 1 of your Digimon" effect and the "return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of the deck" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to search my security stack but choose to not digivolve?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can choose to not digivolve.
In such cases, you shuffle all of the searched cards and return them to the security stack.

qa.question: When exactly is the timing for the digivolution bonus draw when a digivolution would occur by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer:
You perform the digivolution bonus draw when a card is placed on top of the Digimon to digivolve.
A digivolution includes the bonus draw in accordance with the rules.
After the card to digivolve is stacked and the digivolution bonus draw is performed, you process the remaining effects.

qa.question: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve, can I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect before returning the remaining cards to the security stack?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: I used [BT16-024 MagnaAngemon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into this card, then I placed a card from my hand at the bottom of my security stack. At such times, does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect or its [All Turns] effect activate first?
qa.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player chooses the activation order.

qa.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect activate when performing a non-DNA digivolve?
qa.answer:
The "suspend all of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon" part activates even if not DNA digivolving.
The "none of their Digimon can unsuspend until the end of their turn" part only activates if DNA digivolving.

qa.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] would be deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
<Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> and this card's <Delay> effect will trigger simultaneously, but if you use this card's effect to digivolve first, the triggered <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> on BT16-025 [Paildramon] will be negated and won't activate.

qa.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect can't be activated because it doesn't trigger when the Digimon is deleted by an opponent's effect.

qa.question: When a Digimon with BT16-025 [Paildramon] in its digivolution cards is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's <Delay> effect to digivolve?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
<Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> and this card's <Delay> effect will trigger simultaneously, and the triggered <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> on BT16-025 [Paildramon] can be activated, even if you use this card's effect to digivolve first.

qa.question: Which effect activates first, an [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect on an opponent's Digimon that was played/digivolved, or this card's [All Turns] effect?
qa.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player activates their effect first.

qa.question: When does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger, exactly?
qa.answer:
It will trigger when a Digimon is played by an effect such as the effect on BT5-092 [Nokia Shiramine] or when a Digimon digivolves by an effect such as the effect on P-103 [Offense Training].
It won't trigger for effects that aren't digivolution effects, such as BT4-011 [Agunimon]'s effect that treats a Tamer as a level 3 red Digimon or BT6-060 [Deputymon]'s effect that allows digivolution requirements to be ignored.

qa.question: If the cards I reveal for this card's [On Play] effect include only two types of cards, one being a [Night Claw] trait card and one being a 2-color card, can I add both types to the hand?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
You can only add 1 [Night Claw] trait or 1 2-color card to the hand.

qa.question: When I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] effect to digivolve it into a level 4 Digimon card with the [Holy Beast]/[Free] trait in the trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

qa.question: What does "end the attack" mean, exactly?
qa.answer: After this effect activates, the current timing makes a transition to the end of attack timing. For example, if this effect activates during the attack declaration timing, it will make a transition to the end of attack timing. A transition to the counter timing or block timing won't occur, and the attack won't succeed.

qa.question: Can an "end the attack" effect end an attack by a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?
qa.answer:
Yes, such attacks can be ended.
"End the attack" effects are effects that change the timing, they don't affect an attacking Digimon.

qa.question: This Digimon attacked a player and a security check occurred. If this card leaves the battle area due to the revealed card's [Security] effect, does this card’s [Your Turn] effect activate?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn’t activate.
The effect triggers when a card is removed from a security stack, but this card is removed from the battle area before it can activate.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP until the end of their turn" effect and the "1 of their Digimon gains <Security A. -2> until the end of their turn" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: Does this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect activate when a player has 0 cards in their security stack?
qa.answer:
Yes, it activates.
In such cases, only the player with 1 or more security cards trashes the top card of their security stack.

qa.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include only either a card with [Pulsemon] in its text or a card with the [Abadin Electronics] trait, can I only add 1 card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.

qa.question: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include both a card with [Pulsemon] in its text and a card with the [Abadin Electronics] trait, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: When I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] effect to digivolve it into a level 4 Digimon card with the [Insectoid]/[Free] trait in the trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

qa.question: I used [BT16-085 Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji]'s [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to play [BT16-040 Wormmon], it digivolved into this Digimon, then I used the [End of Your Turn] effect to move it to the breeding area. At such times, does [BT16-085 Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji]'s effect return this Digimon to the hand?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't.
An effect that targets this Digimon will continue targeting it even if it's moved to the breeding area, but because it isn't affected by effects while in the breeding area, it isn't returned to the hand.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect and the "gain 1 memory" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. It can't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase" effect and the "gain 2 memory" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: When my Digimon with the [Insectoid] trait and this card in its digivolution cards is suspended, can this card's inherited effect switch the target of an opponent's Digimon's attack to that Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect suspend 1 each of my opponent's Digimon and Tamers?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "trash the top card of your opponent's security stack" effect and the "gain 2 memory" effect when activating this card's [All Turns] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect prevent [Security] effects on my opponent's Security Digimon from affecting this Digimon while it's suspended?
qa.answer:
Yes, it isn't affected.
[Security] effects on Security Digimon are treated as Digimon effects, so the "this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon" effect prevents such effects from affecting this Digimon.

qa.question: What does a "your opponent can't play XX by effects" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer:
Such effects prevent your opponent from playing XX by effects.
With this card's effect, your opponent can no longer play Digimon by effects such as BT10-018 [Gaossmon]'s [On Deletion] effect or BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon]'s [When Digivolving] effect.
This effect affects the opponent player.

qa.question: I chose my opponent's BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect. If BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] then attacks and is suspended at the start of the main phase, does its gained <Collision> activate?
qa.answer:
No, <Collision> doesn't activate.
As soon as BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon] suspends, its [All Turns] effect prevents it from being affected by your effects, and <Collision> doesn't activate.

qa.question: Does this card's effect reference the card for the Digimon before or after it digivolves?
qa.answer: It references the Digimon after it digivolves.

qa.question: What does "this Digimon can't leave the battle area other than by deletion" in this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect mean, exactly?
qa.answer:
It means that this Digimon can no longer leave the battle area by processing other than deletion. Such processing includes "return to the hand/deck," "place in the security stack," and "place under another Digimon or Tamer."
It only leaves the battle area by deletion.

qa.question: If a Digimon that's affected by this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect would be trashed because it has no DP, is it still prevented from leaving the battle area?
qa.answer:
No, the card is trashed.
Digimon without DP can't be in the battle area according to the rules, therefore upon the rule check timing, the card is considered a card that doesn't belong in the battle area and is trashed.
This is why that card is trashed even if that Digimon is affected by this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon can't have its DP reduced by your opponent's effects and isn't affected by <De-Digivolve> effects" effect and the "1 of your Digimon gains <Blocker> and <Reboot> until the end of your opponent's turn" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: When my opponent had 2 cards in their security attack, they activated [ST10-06 Mastemon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, and the effect that places a card from their trash in their security stack and the effect that plays a level 5 or lower Digimon card activated. My opponent temporarily has 3 cards in their security stack, then it becomes 2 cards. Can I activate this card's [All Turns] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
Even if an effect activates and increases your opponent's security stack, their security stack must have 3 or more cards when the effect finishes activating.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "<De-Digivolve 1> 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect and the "delete 1 of their Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less" effect when activating this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: If I use the "reduce the play costs of all of your opponent's Digimon by 1" effect and all of my opponent's Digimon have their play costs reduced by 3, does an opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 2 now have a play cost of -1?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't. The minimum value is 0, the resulting play cost can't be negative.

qa.question: If I use the "reduce the play costs of all of your opponent's Digimon by 1" effect, is the play cost also reduced for Digimon cards in areas other than the battle area (such as my opponent's hand or trash)?
qa.answer: No, it isn't. This card's effect only reduces the play costs of Digimon in your opponent's battle area.

qa.question: When I use this card's [All Turns] effect to digivolve it into a Digimon card with the [Beast Dragon]/[Undead]/[SoC] trait in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

qa.question: When digivolving into this card, do the [When Digivolving] effects on digivolution cards with [Gammamon] in their names activate?
qa.answer:
Yes, they activate.
This card's "This Digimon gains all effects of cards with [Gammamon] in their names in this Digimon's digivolution cards" effect is an [All Turns] effect, so it will activate as soon as the digivolution is confirmed. Therefore, [When Evolving] effects are gained and will trigger.

qa.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect activate when performing a non-DNA digivolve?
qa.answer:
The "until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of their Digimon" part activates even if not DNA digivolving.
The "place 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the number of cards in your or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack" part only activates if DNA digivolving.

qa.question: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect place 1 of my opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the total number of cards in my or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack?
qa.answer: No, this effect places 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the number of cards in either your or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack, not the total number of cards.

qa.question: I have 5 security cards, and my opponent has 1 security card. Can I refer to the number of my opponent's security cards for this card's [When Digivolving] effect so I don't place their Digimon at the bottom of the security stack?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
If your opponent has a Digimon with as high or lower a level than the number of either your or your opponent's security cards, you must place those Digimon at the bottom of their security stack for this card's [When Digivolving] effect.

qa.question: Does the "when this card would be played" effect also activate when my opponent has a Digimon with the [Boss] trait?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: When this card would be played, if there is a Digimon with the [Boss] trait, and I can return 6 cards with the [D-Brigade] trait from my trash to the top of the deck, can I reduce the play cost by 12?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Which player chooses whether or not a card is trashed and chooses the card to trash for this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] [When Digivolving]effect?
qa.answer: Your opponent chooses both.

qa.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can process it.
Even if [Gesomon] or [X Antibody] isn't in this card's digivolution cards, this card's [When Digivolving] effect will prevent 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers without cards under it from suspending.

qa.question: What kind of state does "with cards under it" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect refer to?
qa.answer: It refers to a state where a card has one or more cards such as digivolution cards stacked under it.

qa.question: Can I choose my [LM-020 Quantumon] that isn't affected by Digimon effects as the target of this card's [When Digivolving] effect, then delete just my opponent's Digimon without deleting my [LM-020 Quantumon]?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to digivolve it into a Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in my hand/trash regardless of its digivolution requirements?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

qa.question: 2 copies of this Digimon are deleted at the same time, and their [On Deletion] effects triggered simultaneously. Can I play 1 Tamer card with [Myotismon] in its text when the 1st effect activates, then use the 2nd effect to play a Tamer card with the same name as the Tamer card played by the 1st effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: 2 copies of this Digimon are deleted at the same time, and their [On Deletion] effects triggered simultaneously. Can I play 1 Tamer card with [Myotismon] in its text when the 1st effect activates, then use the 2nd effect to play a Tamer card with the same name as the Tamer card played by the 1st effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "<Draw 2> and trash 1 card in your hand" effect and the "you may play 1 Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text and 6000 DP or less from your trash without paying the cost. At the next end of your opponent’s turn, delete it" effect when activating this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: Do I delete the Digimon that was played by this card's [When Digivolving] effect at the end of my opponent's turn?
qa.answer:
No, you only delete it at the end of your opponent's first turn after it's played by this effect.
If another effect prevents it from being deleted at the end of your opponent's first turn when it would be deleted, that Digimon isn't deleted at the end of your opponent's following turns.

qa.question: What is the processing order for an effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion of a Digimon played by this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: The pending processing for the effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion at the end of the turn are considered to be processing that triggers simultaneously. Therefore, the turn player can choose the processing order.

qa.question: When I use this card's [All Turns] effect to digivolve into [Fenriloogamon] in my trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

No, you can't.
The Digimon that was given <Rush> by this effect must attack if possible.

qa.question: I use BT16-077 [Dinobeemon]'s [When Digivolving] effect to play this card, give <Rush> to BT16-077 [Dinobeemon], and attack a player. Can I then use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to attack with this card?
qa.answer:
No, it can't attack. A new attack declaration can't be made during an attack.
In this case, BT16-077 [Dinobeemon] is already attacking using its [When Digivolving] effect.
This card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect can be activated before the counter timing, but because you can't declare another attack during an attack, you won't be able to attack using this effect, even if you activate it.

qa.question: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to play a card with an [On Play] effect, in what order do I process the part of this card's effect after "then" and the played card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer:
You first process the part of this card's effect after "then."
You use the part of this card's effect after "then" to give <Rush> to 1 of your Digimon, then that Digimon attacks.
After that, the [On Play] effect of the played card will activate before the counter timing.

qa.question: If only I have a level 4 or lower Digimon, can I choose to not activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect and not delete my level 4 or lower Digimon?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn" effect and the "delete 1 of their unsuspended Digimon" effect when activating this card's [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: How exactly do I perform "<Recovery +1 (Deck)> until there are 3 cards in your security stack" in this card’s [On Deletion] effect?
qa.answer: If you have 2 or fewer cards in your security stack when the effect activates, repeat <Recovery +1 (Deck)> until there are 3 cards in your security stack. You don't have to do anything when the effect activates if you have 3 or more cards in your security stack.

qa.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate when this Digimon itself moves from the breeding area to the battle area?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: When one of my Digimon moves from the breeding area to the battle area during the breeding phase, does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate during the breeding phase or main phase?
qa.answer: It activates during the breeding phase. If effects trigger during the breeding phase, the main phase will come after all effects have activated.

qa.question: I moved one of my Digimon from the breeding area to the battle area when all of my Digimon's DP is reduced by an effect. The moved Digimon's DP becomes 0 and is deleted due to the DP-reducing effect, but does this card's [All Turns] effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: I moved this card from the breeding area to the battle area when all of my Digimon's DP is reduced by an effect. At such times, if this card's DP becomes 0 and is deleted due to the DP-reducing effect after it's moved, can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
When a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves an area while activation is pending, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, the effect triggers when this card is moved, but because the DP becomes 0 before activation, this card is deleted and removed from the battle area, and the effect can't be activated.

qa.question: Does this card's [On Deletion] effect return all Tamers of both players to their owners' hands?
qa.answer: Yes, it returns all Tamers of both players to their owners' hands.

qa.question: I activated this card's [End of Your Turn] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. Can I then process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's effect?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.

qa.question: When I would play a Digimon card to the breeding area, can I perform a DigiXros or Assembly for the card to be played?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: When a Digimon is played to the breeding area, does that Digimon's [On Play] effects or "when a Digimon is played" effects trigger?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't trigger.

qa.question: The Digimon played using this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect digivolved. Is that Digimon returned to the hand at the end of my opponent's turn?
qa.answer: Yes, it's returned. In such cases, only the top card is returned to the hand and all digivolution cards are trashed.

qa.question: When one of my Digimon DNA digivolves into a red or yellow Digimon, does the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn" effect activate even if I don't suspend this Tamer?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn’t activate.
The rest of the effect won't activate if you don't perform the specified action in effects with "by X" conditions.

qa.question: The Digimon played using this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect digivolved. Is that Digimon returned to the hand at the end of my opponent's turn?
qa.answer: Yes, it's returned. In such cases, only the top card is returned to the hand and all digivolution cards are trashed.

qa.question: When one of my Digimon DNA digivolves into a blue or green Digimon, does the "trash any 3 digivolution cards under your opponent's Digimon" effect activate even if I don't suspend this Tamer?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn’t activate.
The rest of the effect won't activate if you don't perform the specified action in effects with "by X" conditions.

qa.question: I used [BT16-085 Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji]'s [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to play [BT16-040 Wormmon], it digivolved into this Digimon, then I used the [End of Your Turn] effect to move it to the breeding area. At such times, does [BT16-085 Davis Motomiya & Ken Ichijoji]'s effect return this Digimon to the hand?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't.
An effect that targets this Digimon will continue targeting it even if it's moved to the breeding area, but because it isn't affected by effects while in the breeding area, it isn't returned to the hand.

qa.question: Can I use the [End of All Turns] effect in this card's inherited effect to play this card itself when this card is in a Digimon's digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use the [End of All Turns] effect in this card's inherited effect to play this card itself when this card is in a Digimon's digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: The Digimon played using this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect digivolved. Is that Digimon returned to the hand at the end of my opponent's turn?
qa.answer: Yes, it's returned. In such cases, only the top card is returned to the hand and all digivolution cards are trashed.

qa.question: When one of my Digimon DNA digivolves into a black or yellow Digimon, does the "<De-Digivolve 1> 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect activate even if I don't suspend this Tamer?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn’t activate.
The rest of the effect won't activate if you don't perform the specified action in effects with "by X" conditions.

qa.question: The Digimon played using this card's [On Deletion] effect digivolved. Is that Digimon deleted at the end of my opponent's turn?
qa.answer: Yes, it's deleted.

qa.question: Do I delete the Digimon that was played by this card's [On Deletion] effect at the end of my opponent's turn?
qa.answer:
No, you only delete it at the end of your opponent's first turn after it's played by this effect.
If another effect prevents it from being deleted at the end of your opponent's first turn when it would be deleted, that Digimon isn't deleted at the end of your opponent's following turns.

qa.question: What is the processing order for an effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion of a Digimon played by this card's [On Deletion] effect?
qa.answer: The pending processing for the effect that triggers at the end of the turn and the deletion at the end of the turn are considered to be processing that triggers simultaneously. Therefore, the turn player can choose the processing order.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to trash 1 Digi-Egg card in the breeding area?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
Digi-Egg cards in the battle area and breeding area are treated as Digimon, so they can be trashed.

qa.question: Can I perform just "deleting 1 of your [Ukkomon]" or "trashing 1 of your Digimon in the breeding area" to play a [BigUkkomon] into the breeding area for this card's [Main] effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
You must perform both "deleting 1 of your [Ukkomon] and trashing 1 of your Digimon in the breeding area" to play a [BigUkkomon] into the breeding area.

qa.question: After performing "deleting 1 of your [Ukkomon]" and "trashing 1 of your Digimon in the breeding area," can I choose to not play a [BigUkkomon] into the breeding area for this card's [Main] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, the effect reads “you may play."

qa.question: Is <Overflow> processed when this card's [Main] effect trashes a Digimon with <Overflow> in the breeding area?
qa.answer:
Yes, it's processed.
<Overflow> is processed when a card is sent from the area or from under a card to another area. In this case, it's processed because a card from the area is placed in the trash.

qa.question: Is <Overflow> processed when this card's [Main] effect trashes a Digimon in the breeding area that has a card with <Overflow> in its digivolution cards?
qa.answer:
Yes, it's processed.
<Overflow> is processed when a card is sent from the area or from under a card to another area. In this case, it's processed because it's placed into the trash from under a card.

changes.before: [Main] You may play 1 [Aquilamon] or [Gatomon] from your hand without paying the cost. Then, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand. The Digimon this effect DNA digivolved gains ⟨Security A. +1⟩ for the turn and may attack a player.
changes.after: [Main] You may play 1 [Aquilamon] or [Gatomon] from your hand without paying the cost. Then, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand. The Digimon this effect DNA digivolved may gain ⟨Security A. +1⟩ for the turn and attack a player.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: I used [BT16-091 Beastly Storm Dance of Affection]'s effect to DNA digivolve into this card, then I used [BT16-091 Beastly Storm Dance of Affection]'s effect to attack. At such times, can a Digimon played using this card's [When Digivolving] effect gain <Rush> and attack?
qa.answer: Because [BT16-077 Dinobeemon] is already using [BT16-091 Beastly Storm Dance of Affection]'s effect to attack, a played Digimon can gain <Rush>, but it can't use this card's effect to attack.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to play Digimon without DNA digivolving?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I choose to not play Digimon for this card's [Main] effect but DNA digivolve using 2 of my Digimon that were already in the battle area?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to give the DNA digivolved Digimon <Security A. +1> without attacking?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
You must choose to gain <Security A. +1> and attack a player or choose to neither gain <Security A. +1> or attack.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to play Digimon without DNA digivolving?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I choose to not play Digimon for this card's [Main] effect but DNA digivolve using 2 of my Digimon that were already in the battle area?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to play Digimon without DNA digivolving?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I choose to not play Digimon for this card's [Main] effect but DNA digivolve using 2 of my Digimon that were already in the battle area?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I activate the part after "then" in this card's effect if I don't have a Digimon with [Dorugoramon] in its name ?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I have 5 cards in my security stack. Can I use this card’s "when this card would be used" effect to only trash 1 security card and reduce the cost by 2?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: My Digimon attacks and digivolves into this card by an effect during the attack. Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack again?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
An attack declaration can't be made during an attack.

qa.question: This card is in the battle area, and it has X Antibody in its digivolution cards. My opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less and a [When Attacking] effect attacks, and now it's suspended. At such times, this card's [All Turns] effect causes that Digimon's DP to become 0. Which is processed first, the deletion by a rule check or that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect?
qa.answer:
The deletion by a rule check is processed first.
As soon as your opponent's Digimon attacks and suspends, that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect triggers, but the rule check occurs before it activates. The Digimon with 0 DP will be deleted upon the rule check before the [When Attacking] effect can activate.

qa.question: When "isn't affected by your opponent's effects" is gained from this card's [When Digivolving] effect, can the target of attack be switched to this Digimon using a "switch the target of attack" effect such as <Raid> on an opponent's Digimon?
qa.answer:
Yes, it can.
A "switch the target of attack" effect such as <Raid> affects the attacking Digimon itself, therefore the target of attack can be switched to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects.

qa.question: Does this card’s [All Turns] effect activate when a security card is removed from my security stack by one of my own effects?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates.

qa.question: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can process it.
Even if [Magnamon (X Antibody)] or an [Armor Form] trait card isn't in this card's digivolution cards, this card's [When Digivolving] effect will unsuspend this Digimon.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0225.title: <Piercing>
comprehensive-0225.text:
16-7. <Piercing>
16-7-1. <Piercing> is a keyword effect that reads "When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends." (For details, refer to 13 "Security Checks")
16-7-2. <Piercing> is a trigger-type effect that triggers and activates when a Digimon with this effect battles an opponent's Digimon and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger- Type Effects")
16-7-3. The security check from using <Piercing> is mandatory.
16-7-4. <Piercing> is pending processing that is processed immediately before the transition to the end of attack timing. Therefore, it will trigger simultaneously with effects triggered by the battle, but it is processed before the end of the attack. (Example: If a Digimon with <Piercing> attacks and deletes a Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect in the battle, first the [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then <Piercing> is processed.)
16-7-5. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of cards that can be checked by the attacking Digimon is modified, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
16-7-6. If there are no Digimon to perform a security check at the point when <Piercing> is processed, a security check won't be possible.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0227.title: <Jamming>
comprehensive-0227.text:
16-9. <Jamming>
16-9-1. <Jamming> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect isn't deleted as a result of a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon.
16-9-2. <Jamming> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0233.title: <Rush>
comprehensive-0233.text:
16-15. <Rush>
16-15-1. <Rush> is a keyword effect where the Digimon with this effect can also attack in the same turn it was played.
16-15-2. <Rush> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0234.title: <Blitz>
comprehensive-0234.text:
16-16. <Blitz>
16-16-1. <Blitz> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect can attack if your opponent has 1 or more memory.
16-16-2. <Blitz> effects execute processing.
16-16-3. <Blitz> has a processing condition that requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side. "This Digimon may attack" is optional processing.
16-16-4. After using <Blitz> to make an attack declaration, the attack will proceed even if the memory moves to 0 or more.38
16-16-5. An attack can't be made using <Blitz> if the memory is at 0 or more upon activating <Blitz>.

comprehensive-0235.title: <Delay>
comprehensive-0235.text:
16-17. <Delay>
16-17-1. <Delay> is a keyword effect. While a card with this effect is in the battle area, by trashing that card, the effect specified in <Delay> will activate.
16-17-2. The processing from <Delay> is optional. (For details, refer to 15-7 "Optional Processing Conditions")
16-17-3. <Delay> can't be activated the same turn the card with the effect is placed in the battle area.

comprehensive-0236.title: <Decoy>
comprehensive-0236.text:
16-18. <Decoy>
16-18-1. <Decoy> is a keyword effect. When another of your specified Digimon would be deleted by an opponent's effect, by deleting the Digimon with this effect, <Decoy> prevents the Digimon specified by this effect from being deleted. This is shown on cards using text such as <Decoy (Black)>.
16-18-2. <Decoy> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when another of your Digimon specified by this effect would be deleted by an opponent's effect (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-18-3. "By deleting this Digimon" in <Decoy> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "<Decoy> prevents the Digimon specified by this effect from being deleted" will be mandatory.

comprehensive-0237.title: <Armor Purge>
comprehensive-0237.text:
16-19. <Armor Purge>
16-19-1. <Armor Purge> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with <Armor Purge> would be deleted, by trashing the top card of the Digimon with this effect, this effect prevents the deletion.
16-19-2. <Armor Purge> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-19-3. "By trashing the top card of the Digimon" in <Armor Purge> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "prevents the deletion" will be mandatory.

comprehensive-0242.title: <Raid>
comprehensive-0242.text:
16-23. <Raid>
16-23-1. <Raid> is a keyword effect that can switch the target of attack to the opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP when a Digimon with this keyword effect attacks.
16-23-2. <Raid> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when a Digimon with this effect attacks. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-23-3. The processing from <Raid> is optional.
16-23-4. If the opponent has multiple unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP when <Raid> activates, the player that activated the effect chooses a Digimon from among them and the attack target is switched to it.

comprehensive-0243.title: <Alliance>
comprehensive-0243.text:
16-24. <Alliance>
16-24-1. <Alliance> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with this effect attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, add the suspended Digimon's DP to the attacking Digimon and it gains <Security A. +1> for the attack.
16-24-2. <Alliance> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when a Digimon with this effect attacks. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-24-3. "By suspending 1 of your other Digimon" in <Alliance> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "when a Digimon with this effect attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, add the suspended Digimon's DP to the attacking Digimon and it gains <Security A. +1> for the attack" will be mandatory.
16-24-4. The value added to DP by <Alliance> is the value of the suspended Digimon upon the suspension. The added DP from <Alliance> isn't modified, even if the DP of your suspended Digimon is later modified.
16-24-5. Even if your Digimon that was suspended by <Alliance> is removed from the battle area during the attack, the added DP and <Security A. +1> remain.

comprehensive-0244.title: <Barrier>
comprehensive-0244.text:
16-25. <Barrier>
16-25-1. <Barrier> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with this effect would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, this effect prevents that deletion.
16-25-2. <Barrier> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-25-3. "By trashing the top card of your security stack" in <Barrier> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "prevents the deletion" will be mandatory.

comprehensive-0245.title: <Blast Digivolve>
comprehensive-0245.text:
16-26. <Blast Digivolve>
16-26-1. <Blast Digivolve> is a keyword effect that allows one of your Digimon to digivolve into a card with this keyword effect in the hand without paying the cost.
16-26-2. <Blast Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-26-3. The processing from <Blast Digivolve> is optional.
16-26-4. <Blast Digivolve> is an effect that digivolves the chosen Digimon in the battle area.

comprehensive-0247.title: <Mind Link>
comprehensive-0247.text:
16-28. <Mind Link>
16-28-1. <Mind Link> is a keyword effect that places a Tamer with this effect in the digivolution cards of a Digimon with no Tamer cards in its digivolution cards.
16-28-2. <Mind Link> effects execute processing.
16-28-3. The processing from <Mind Link> is mandatory. However, if it uses the [Main] activation timing, it can be activated and processed at a timing chosen by the player.

comprehensive-0248.title: <Partition>
comprehensive-0248.text:
16-29. <Partition>
16-29-1. <Partition> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with this effect and 1 of each of the specified cards in its digivolution cards would be removed from the battle area other than by one of your effects or a battle, you may play 1 of each of the specified cards from the digivolution cards without paying their costs. This is shown on cards using text such as "<Partition (blue Lv.4 & green Lv.4)>."
16-29-2. <Partition> is an immediate-type effect that triggers "when a Digimon with this effect and 1 of each of the specified cards in its digivolution cards would be removed from the battle area other than by one of your effects or a battle." (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-29-3. The processing from <Partition> is optional.
16-29-4. When <Partition> is activated, 1 of each of the specified cards is played from digivolution cards without paying their costs. A player can't choose to only play one or some of the specified cards.

comprehensive-0249.title: <Collision>
comprehensive-0249.text:
16-30. <Collision>
16-30-1. <Collision> is a keyword effect. While a Digimon with this effect is attacking, all of your opponent's Digimon gain <Blocker> and the opponent player is forced to block whenever possible during the block timing.
16-30-2. <Collision> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-30-3. <Collision> will activate while the Digimon with this effect is attacking.
16-30-4. "All of your opponent's Digimon gain <Blocker>" in <Collision> is processing that affects Digimon. "The opponent player is forced to block whenever possible" is processing that affects the opponent player.
